summary: Register versioned GO, STOP and typed compatibility-signoff deployment audit claims without activating an installer or verifier.

replay.detail: No new projection or replay. Older registries retain authenticated unknown deployment envelopes for upgrade retry while existing read surfaces ignore them.

schema.detail: Add six durable resource-subject kinds: deploy.go, deploy.go-revoked, deploy.go-consumed, deploy.stop, deploy.stop-lifted and deploy.compat-signoff. All require version 1. GO binds required preview evidence, exact package identities, typed signoff reference, optional combined STOP/plan and a positive expiry interval bounded by four hours.

rules.detail: All deployment records are durable; no checkpoint drop rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Existing kinds are unchanged. Unknown deployment kinds are quarantined without changing existing projections or list output. Unsupported deployment versions are refused. No new signing keys or trust root. Versioned convergence corpus v8 and schema-valid deployment input generation cover all six kinds.

manual.detail: No callable deployment command or installer entry is introduced. Schema validity alone does not authorize deployment.

recovery.detail: Existing authenticated unknown-record retention and retry remain authoritative.
